response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len, AVG(rental_rate) * 1.0 / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), m AS (SELECT AVG(per_day) AS mean_pd FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_len) AS avg_of_avg_length, AVG(r.per_day) AS avg_per_day_price, AVG(r.per_day - m.mean_pd) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM r CROSS JOIN m WHERE r.per_day > m.mean_pd

assumptions.assumption: The 'ignoring films with no length' condition applies only to the average length. AVG(length) skips NULLs on its own. The average rental_rate and average rental_duration still use all films in each rating.
The cross-rating mean is the unweighted mean of the per-rating per-day prices, taken over all 5 ratings. Ratings are not weighted by film count.
